summary: Ryman Hospitality Properties, via subsidiary RHP Property GLO, LLC, completed its acquisition of the JW Marriott Orlando Grande Lakes and Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes for ~$1.38 billion from GLO Hotel Owner LLC. Funding combined net proceeds of a 5,865,000-share common stock offering at $117.00/share, $700M of 6.250% senior notes due 2035, and cash. The deal closed September 1, 2026; 2026 guidance was revised. Watch integration performance and post-deal leverage trends.
